ValidationRule.description: Stage gate: Exhibitor sales, Confirmed and later stages need Amount, Stand size (sqm), Contract signed date and Deposit received.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(RecordType.DeveloperName = "Exhibitor_sales", CASE(StageName, "Enquiry", 1, "Qualified", 2, "Space held", 3, "Contract sent", 4, "Confirmed", 5, 0) >= 5, OR(ISBLANK(Amount), ISBLANK(Stand_size_sqm__c), ISBLANK(Contract_signed_date__c), NOT(Deposit_received__c)))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Fill in Amount, Stand size (sqm), Contract signed date and Deposit received before moving to Confirmed.
